=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text tgood ": good\n"
text tbad ": bad\n"
text i1 "978-0596528126"
text i2 "978-0596528120"
text i3 "978-1788399081"
text i4 "978-1788399083"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note digits weigh 1, 3, 1, 3, ... skipping hyphens; valid when there are 13 and the sum is 0 mod 10
fn isbn a view uchar * to bool
s = ulong 0
k = ulong 0
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
if and ge c 48 le c 57
d = ulong sub c 48
if eq rem k 2 1
d = mul d 3
end
s = add s d
k = add k 1
end
end
ret and eq k 13 eq rem s 10 0
end
fn show a view uchar * to void
emit a
if isbn a
emit tgood
else
emit tbad
end
end
fn main to int
show i1
show i2
show i3
show i4
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
978-0596528126: good
978-0596528120: bad
978-1788399081: good
978-1788399083: bad
</pre>
